lock_reaches_natural_expiry.meaning: the user's lock reaches its natural expiry without manual extension
lock_reaches_natural_expiry.checkpoint: before claimRewards for the expiry epoch

lock_end_le_epoch_end.meaning: the lock end timestamp is at or before the end timestamp of the epoch in which the lock expires
lock_end_le_epoch_end.checkpoint: before claimRewards for the expiry epoch

user_bonded_in_final_epoch.meaning: the user was bonded for part or all of the epoch in which the lock expires
user_bonded_in_final_epoch.checkpoint: before claimRewards for the expiry epoch

user_received_rewards.meaning: rewards the user actually receives for the expiry epoch (0 in the reported violation)
user_received_rewards.checkpoint: after claimRewards for the expiry epoch

pro_rata_share.meaning: the user's pro-rata share of the expiry epoch's rewards given their bonded duration in that epoch

claims.scope: claimRewards computes rewards for prevEpoch using userBondedBalanceAtEpochEnd(prevEpoch)

preconditions.text: A user's lock reaches its natural expiry without manual extension.; The lock end is at or before the end timestamp of the epoch in which the lock expires (due to week-rounding).; The user was bonded for part or all of the epoch in which the lock expires.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: A user bonded for part or all of an epoch should receive their pro-rata share of that epoch's rewards, not zero.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: A user bonded for an entire epoch receiving 0% of their pro-rata share contradicts the documented pro-rata allocation guarantee.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: Rewards for epoch n become claimable in epoch n+1 and are forfeited if not claimed before the next epoch ends.
The user's pro-rata share for the expiry epoch is positive because they were bonded for part or all of that epoch.

limitations: The pro-rata share is represented as a symbolic reward-token quantity rather than a duration-weighted formula because the report supplies no explicit allocation equation.
The claim window assumption is recorded as context and not encoded as a precondition term.
